recommendation: Keep the source commit. FMG may separately refresh the external Confluence page content for newer releases, but the core specification source should continue to expose the release-known-issues entry point.
issue_request: FHIR-26374 was Published/Persuasive with Modification and asked for a known issues/errata page so implementers can discover issues found between publication and a corrected build. FMG resolved that R4B and following releases should include a Known Issues link with explanatory text to a release-specific Confluence page for FMG-approved technical-correction candidates.
initial_application: The R4B branch applied the issue in source/index.html through 11af3f17 and b21e69dd on 2022-04-08, and 8219fa75 added the same Confluence known-issues link to source/history.html while fixing the link. Current trunk no longer contained the release-specific Confluence link; source/versions.html only referred generally to the FHIR change-request tracker.
additional_context: The 2021-12-08 FMG minutes confirm the FHIR-26374 motion and 4-0-0 vote. The Confluence page Known Issues with the published FHIR Specifications still exists under the FHIR space and is the external target used by the historical source application. source/index.html is the active home page source and the page family originally used for the issue application.
reconciliation: Added an explanatory home-page note linking the text Known Issues to the release-specific Confluence page. No generated artifacts were edited, and the external Confluence page content was left outside this core-source reconciliation.
source_changes: source/index.html: added a release-specific Known Issues note linking to the FHIR Confluence known-issues page for published specifications.
